External Tools

Local evidence capture tools stay outside the lego atom catalog and publish normalized artifacts only.

claude-tap
https://github.com/liaohch3/claude-tap
Network proxy records provider-visible payloads and stream reconstruction, not private in-process native internals. / Helix normalized artifacts keep fingerprints and summaries by default instead of raw prompt or tool payloads.
gap nanobot: Add a Helix-owned Nanobot capture path or wait for upstream claude-tap Nanobot client support before using external capture as Nanobot native evidence.
